comments.name: Ruth
comments.message: As a first-time visitor to the garden, it was wonderful to discover that the "nametags" on the trees included the names of the folks and families who had fostered them. A big thank you to the 275 people who helped create this beautiful forest!

comments.message: The forest has been beautiful in its autumn colors!
